question.en: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
question.zh: 男孩到了他想去的地方吗？

sentences.en: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
sentences.zh: 男孩到了他想去的地方吗？

sentences.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
sentences.zh: 逃学的孩子们都缺乏想像力。

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
sentences.zh: 或在电影院里坐上八个小时，一遍遍地看同一部电影，他们通常也就做到这种程度。

chunks.x: in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again
seeing the same film over and over again

sentences.en: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant travelled 1, 600 miles.
sentences.zh: 有一个逃学的男孩却使所有这些人相形见绌，他旅行了1,600英里。

chunks.x: by a boy who while playing truant travelled 1 600 miles

sentences.en: He hitchhiked to Dover and towards evening
sentences.zh: 他搭便车到了多佛，天快黑时

sentences.en: went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
sentences.zh: 钻进一条船里找个地方睡觉。

sentences.en: When he woke up next morning,
he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
sentences.zh: 发现船在这段时间里已经开到了加来。

chunks.x: that the boat had in the meantime travelled to Calais

sentences.en: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
sentences.zh: 他偷偷下船时没人注意到他。

sentences.en: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
sentences.zh: 从那里他又搭上一辆卡车到了巴黎。

sentences.en: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
sentences.zh: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，把他在城外丢下。

sentences.en: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would,
sentences.zh: 男孩拦住的下一辆车没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，

sentences.en: but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
sentences.zh: 而是把他带到了法西边境的佩皮尼昂。

chunks.x: but to Perpignan on the French Spanish border

sentences.en: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
sentences.zh: 在那里他被一名警察发现，由当地当局送回了英国。

sentences.en: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
sentences.zh: 他无疑为成千上万梦想逃学的孩子们创下了一项纪录。

of children who dream of evading school
